name: maestro
description: Run coding agents in parallel without collisions: plans that say who owns which file, parallel builds with reviews, and chief, an orchestrator that routes work across Claude and Codex.

interface.shortDescription: Run coding agents in parallel without collisions
interface.longDescription: Plans whose tasks each own their files, builds that run them in parallel waves with a review per task, briefs for ad-hoc parallel work, and chief: an orchestrator that delivers a task through Claude and Codex agents, balances both accounts, and reports the cost. Also ships the disciplines the build hands off to: worktrees, test-first, root-cause debugging, verification and code review.
defaultPrompt: Use chief to deliver this feature with a team of agents.
Write a parallel plan for this spec.
